title: 9 minutes to catch the last train out
style: Warm painterly 2D cartoon illustration, cinematic graphic-novel look: clean bold dark outlines, rich textured digital painting, soft volumetric light, deep warm oranges and moody blues, detailed environment, vertical 9:16 composition.

segments.text: Nine minutes. The last train out of the city leaves in nine minutes.
Miss it, and you miss the job interview that changes everything.
Then you see him. An old man. Lost. His dog shaking.
He's holding a ticket for the same train. He can't find platform twelve.
He walks slowly. With him, you need twelve minutes. You have nine.
Run alone, and you both might not make it home tonight.
Here's what nobody tells you. Conductors can sometimes hold the doors for someone who needs help.
But only if somebody reaches them first.
So, do you run ahead and ask them to wait? Or walk him there?
